column1: # Target-symbol normalization for the TPDdb activity tables.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. POI-grouped cross-validation estimates the error on a
# target the model has never seen. That estimate is only honest if no molecule
# measured against a protein appears in the training folds under a different
# spelling. TPDdb's `Target Symbols` column is free text: the same protein
# arrives as `AR`, `Androgen receptor`, `AR L702H` and `AR-V7`, and a composite
# like `KRAS/CRAF` names two proteins at once. Grouping on the raw string would
# put `SMARCA2` and `SMARCA2;SMARCA4` in different folds, leaking the very
# target the fold exists to hold out.
# HOW IT IS USED. `scripts/tpddb-activity-labels.py` maps each raw string to a
# SET of canonical symbols. `scripts/train-surrogate.py --group-by poi` then
# forms groups as the CONNECTED COMPONENTS over shared symbols, so a composite
# lands in the same fold as each of its members. Component sizes are printed,
# because a composite chain can merge two families into one coarse group and
# that is a property of the data a reader has to see.
# CURATION RULES, applied uniformly so the judgment can be audited rather than
#   1. Mutants, isoforms, splice variants and phospho-forms collapse to the
#      gene. `KRAS G12D` and `KRAS G12C` are KRAS; `AR-V7` is AR; `BRD4 long`
#      is BRD4. A degrader selective for a mutant is still trained on that
#      gene's chemistry, so for leakage purposes it is one group.
#   2. Aliases and trivial names resolve to the HGNC symbol. `BCL-xL` is
#      BCL2L1, `CK1α` is CSNK1A1, `HER2` is ERBB2, `Tau` is MAPT.
#   3. Fusions and complexes expand to every protein named. `BCR-ABL` is
#      {BCR, ABL1}; `14-3-3σ/ERα` is {SFN, ESR1}. Order does not matter:
#   4. 14-3-3 paralogs are distinguished, since the glue series target
#      different ones: beta=YWHAB, gamma=YWHAG, zeta=YWHAZ, eta=YWHAH,
#      sigma=SFN. Only those five appear in these tables.
#   5. Non-human targets are tagged `non_human`. They are real measurements but
#      share no chemistry axis with the human panel.
#   6. `ambiguous` means the protein could not be identified from the string
#      with confidence. Those rows are EXCLUDED from the pooled table and the
#      exclusion is printed and recorded in PROVENANCE.json, never silent. A
#      string absent from this file is a different matter: the builder RAISES,
#      because it means the map is out of date.
# `kind` is one of: poi, non_human, ambiguous, unspecified.
# Built 2026-10-26 from the 88 distinct PROTAC and 88 distinct MG
